description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) called BuzzCommentSearchFilterParams, which extends FilterParams. It is used to encapsulate filtering parameters for searching comments associated with a specific share in the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin, including allowed sorting fields and share ID.

classes.name: BuzzCommentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for passing search filter parameters specifically for Buzz comments, including share ID and sort field.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to 'comment.createdAtUtc'.

methods.name: getShareId
methods.description: Returns the share ID associated with the comments filter.

methods.name: setShareId
methods.description: Sets the share ID for the comments filter.
